step.title: What Should I do If my T2353/Omni E25/T2352/Omni E28 shows clean water insuffic…
step.instruction: To resolve the issue you're experiencing, please follow the steps below: Check the clean water tank in the base station. If it's empty, fill it with water and then restart the cleaning task. In most cases, this simple step will resolve the problem. If your robot vacuum starts a task on the same floor where the base station is located, and the issue persists after refilling the water tank and starting a new mopping task, please feel free to contact us for further assistance. Please note: The alert you see is just a reminder from the device. When the robot is operating on a floor without a base station, and the clean water runs low, it will automatically switch to pure vacuum mode to continue the cleaning task. This is a normal protective mechanism designed to ensure the task can still run smoothly even when you're not at home. If the problem continues after refilling the water and starting a new mopping task, don't hesitate to reach out to us again. We're here to help.

step.title: What Should I do If my T2353/Omni E25/T2352/Omni E28 shows clean water insuffic…
step.instruction: To resolve the issue you're experiencing, please follow the steps below: Check the clean water tank in the base station. If it's empty, fill it with water and then restart the cleaning task. In most cases, this simple step will resolve the problem. If your robot vacuum starts a task on the same floor where the base station is located, and the issue persists after refilling the water tank and starting a new mopping task, please feel free to contact us for further assistance. Please note: The alert you see is just a reminder from the device. When the robot is operating on a floor without a base station, and the clean water runs low, it will automatically switch to pure vacuum mode to continue the cleaning task. This is a normal protective mechanism designed to ensure the task can still run smoothly even when you're not at home. If the problem continues after refilling the water and starting a new mopping task, don't hesitate to reach out to us again. We're here to help.
